The camera is completely LOCKED, it does not zoom, push in, orbit or travel. The cat still does not blink and does not move. SECONDS 6-8: the man gives up - he breaks the stare, blinks hard and looks down and away. Only then the cat slowly blinks once, calm and deadpan. Behind them the out-of-focus photographers shift slightly and camera flashes go off softly in the background, out of focus. Photorealistic, shallow depth of field, both faces sharp, background soft. Same grain and lighting as the first frame. No text, no logos, no captions. Audio: a packed hall murmuring and building, camera shutters clicking rapidly, a few whistles, then the crowd starting to laugh and roar. No music, no commentary, no speech.
